exposure: Type of placenta praevia (major vs. minor)
cohort: Women diagnosed with placenta praevia in 10 Austrian hospitals in the province of Styria between 1993 and 2012.
finding: Placenta praevia was associated with high rates of adverse maternal (34.15%) and neonatal (60.06%) outcomes, with major placenta praevia significantly increasing the incidence of preterm delivery, low birth weight, and low Apgar scores.
